text:
raj-sales: Quick heads-up — Acme procurement pushed back on the POC PO. They want a 'Tax ID attestation' line and explicit signer mapping on the PO. Anyone handled this recently?
anya: Can you paste the buyer's exact ask?
raj-sales: Quote from buyer: 'Please include authorized signer's name, title, and company Tax ID (EIN) on the purchase order. Also need attestation that vendor is registered to invoice in the US.' They attached a checklist.
procurement-jess: Yep — we ask for EIN/TIN on PO for billing. For small POCs we sometimes accept a signed attestation email + countersigned PO. Need legal to confirm acceptable wording.
maria-legal: @procurement-jess @raj-sales ok — acceptable for POC. We need either a signed PO with the EIN or a short attestation on company letterhead or DocuSign. Attestation must not change commercial terms. Sample below — feel free to reuse: 
```
I, [Name], [Title], on behalf of [Company Name], hereby attest that [Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc., EIN XX-XXXXXXX] is authorized to issue invoices to [Company Name] using the Tax ID [EIN].
Signature: ___________________  Date: __/__/____
```
maria-legal: Also capture the authorized signer's title and the org unit. If they require MSA/DPA edits, that's a separate legal flow — do not bundle into this attestation.
billing-bot: Automated reminder: our invoice processing requires TIN/EIN on invoices. Missing TIN can delay payment beyond standard terms. See internal playbook: https://redwood.example/processes/invoicing
kyle-csm: For the Acme POC we can accelerate — suggest we prepare a DocuSign envelope with the sample attestation + the PO attached, set signers to Procurement and Billing Manager.
raj-sales: Who can draft the DocuSign? @anya can you prepare a draft with the sample attestation and attach the PO?
anya: I can. I'll add signers: "Acme Procurement" and "Acme Billing Manager" then route to @maria-legal for quick wording check before sending. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:
maria-legal: Quick note — do NOT include any payment/SLA changes in that attestation. If buyer asks for net-term changes or MSA redlines, route to legal and procurement separately.
sam-rector: If Acme insists on exec-level signoff from Finance, we may need their CFO/Finance sign on the PO + a W-9 or equivalent. Happy to help with routing if that happens.
procurement-jess: I'll message the buyer: we can provide the attestation document + countersigned PO via DocuSign. Also request their remittance address and W-9 if they need it for vendor onboarding.
raj-sales: Great — proceed and loop me when sent. Thanks all.
kyle-csm: Follow-up: once signed, I'll attach both docs to Zendesk ticket #4567 and mark for billing to ingest.
raj-sales: Closing loop — please ping if buyer pushes for MSA redlines.
